thread:
alex: Heads-up: Support flagged a confusing 413 for embeddings. Preflight returned OK but shard blew up on mixed dims. Customer sent a tiny batch with two 1024 vectors and rest 512.

meera: do we have the exact curl they used?

alex: sanitized snippet in the ticket:
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"model":"open-embed-512","input":[[...512...],[...1024...],[...512...]]}'
```

vince: If clients don't send any dim hint we estimate by bytes. Mixed dims can exceed per-shard envelope even when total bytes look fine for a uniform dim assumption.

paul: UX-wise this is terrible. Two quick fixes: (A) make preflight return a structured error when mixed dims are detected (422 + machine-readable suggestions), (B) surface a Console inspector hint with exact remediation and sample commands.

lex: small API suggestion: return an extra header on preflight like `X-Estimated-Units: 2.3` and `X-Detected-Dims: 512,1024` when we can detect it. Console can use headers for a lightweight panel instead of parsing bodies.

meera: telemetry needed too. Proposed event name `embed.ingress.shape_detected` with tags: dims_hint_present (y/n), distinct_dims, num_vectors, request_bytes, preflight_outcome (ok/422/runtime_413/auto_split). Hook that into the tenant dashboard.

alex: ops-bot, please create a ticket for telemetry + preflight changes.

ops-bot: created PERF-6012: "embeds: preflight shape detection + telemetry + console hints" and assigned to eng-platform.

vince: runtime question: should we auto-split at ingress if dims absent? pros: fewer user breaks. cons: extra memory copy + extra RPCs to backend shards which can hurt batching. I propose a conservative rule: only auto-split when num_vectors <= 8 (small requests) AND tenant has opted in.

paul: product likes self-serve. Console action should be: "Enable auto-split for your tenant" with an estimated impact card (reduction in 413s, expected latency delta, estimated cost delta). That requires sampling and a simulation endpoint to approximate delta.

lex: safety controls: per-node kill switch, per-tenant toggle, and a global feature flag. Also emit metrics for batch fill-rate so we can detect reduced batching density and roll back.

meera: rollout plan suggestion:
1) 24h: change 413 body to include hint string + add telemetry event (quick win).
2) 3 days: add preflight 422 structured response + `X-Estimated-Units` header. SDKs can parse this.
3) 1 week: console inspector UI + quick actions + simulation endpoint for impact card.
4) 2-4 weeks: gated auto-split canary: 0.1% tenants -> 1% -> 10% with KPIs (413 rate, p95 latency, CPU, batch fill-rate, cost delta).

vince: KPIs for kill conditions: node CPU > 80% sustained, batch fill-rate drop > 15%, p95 latency increase > 40% vs baseline, or cost delta per request > $0.01 absolute (example threshold).

paul: SDK action: server SDKs should start sending `X-Vector-Dims` header automatically in next minor release. We'll add client-side warnings when mixed vectors are constructed.

alex: decision summary: ship telemetry + improved 413 body now; implement preflight 422 + headers; add console inspector hints and sample fixes; implement gated auto-split for small requests with per-tenant opt-in and node-level safety circuit. I'll write a short RFC with owners.

ops-bot: added runbook skeleton to PERF-6012: "embeds-ingress-shape-runbook.md".

meera: I'll take the telemetry + preflight PR. lex will mock the Console inspector. paul will coordinate SDK changes. Vince will prototype node kill-switch. Alex will author RFC.

alex: thanks team. Let's keep the error messages actionable and avoid silent regressions. ✅
